name: Kamatera
tagline: Fully customizable cloud VPS hosting billed by the resources you actually pick
description: Kamatera is a cloud VPS provider that lets you configure CPU, RAM, storage and bandwidth independently rather than picking from fixed bundles, with hourly or monthly billing and a 30-day free trial.
about: Kamatera prices by component instead of bundling a fixed set of specs into a plan name. The entry Availability-tier server starts at $4/month for 1 vCPU, 1GB RAM, 20GB NVMe SSD storage and 5TB of traffic, and every one of those numbers can be dialed up independently — extra storage runs about $0.05/GB per month and extra bandwidth about $0.01/GB. Servers can be billed monthly (prepaid, prorated on mid-month changes) or hourly (billed by the minute, only while powered on), with no long-term contract required either way.

There's no bundled control panel here — Kamatera ships a bare Linux or Windows server image and leaves panel software (cPanel, Plesk, or none at all) up to you to install, which makes it a fit for developers and sysadmins rather than someone wanting a one-click WordPress dashboard out of the box. New accounts get a 30-day free trial worth up to $100 in usage on one server, which is enough to build and load-test a real configuration before paying anything, but the trial converts to standard billing automatically once it ends or the credit runs out, so it's worth setting a calendar reminder to cancel or downgrade if you don't intend to keep the server.
policies: Kamatera offers a 30-day free trial worth up to $100 of usage on one server for new accounts.
Monthly servers are billed with proration for mid-month changes; hourly servers are billed by the minute only while running.
Cancellation charges apply only through the current billing month — no charges are incurred after the month in which you cancel.

faqs.q: Does Kamatera include cPanel or another control panel?
faqs.a: No. Kamatera provisions a bare server image and leaves control-panel software up to you — you can install cPanel, Plesk, or nothing at all, but it isn't bundled or pre-installed by default. This is a self-managed, developer-oriented platform rather than a beginner control-panel host.

faqs.q: How much does Kamatera cost to start?
faqs.a: The entry Availability-tier server starts at $4/month (or an equivalent hourly rate) for 1 vCPU, 1GB RAM, 20GB NVMe SSD storage and 5TB of traffic. Every resource — CPU, RAM, storage, bandwidth — is priced and scaled independently rather than bundled into fixed plan tiers, so actual cost depends on the configuration you choose.

faqs.q: What does Kamatera's free trial actually include?
faqs.a: New accounts get a 30-day free trial covering up to $100 of usage on one server. It's enough to spin up and test a real configuration, but billing starts automatically once the trial period ends or the $100 credit is used, so cancel or downgrade before then if you don't plan to keep paying.

faqs.q: Is Kamatera billed monthly or hourly?
faqs.a: Both options are available. Monthly servers are prepaid with prorated charges for mid-month upgrades, while hourly servers bill by the minute and only charge while the server is powered on. Neither option requires a long-term contract.
